answer: Sybil resistance arises because each agent’s reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life: only sustained honest service preserves score, while inactivity or misconduct rapidly erodes it. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted, reciprocal attestations; transitive support therefore cannot amplify them into consensus, whether labeled pearl, nebula, or lagoon.
